name: Social Autopublish for WoopSocial
author: woopsocial

sections.description:
Social Autopublish for WoopSocial connects your WordPress site to the WoopSocial API. It helps creators, bloggers, agencies, and ecommerce teams ship new posts to connected social accounts through your WoopSocial workspace.

Supported publishing channels (through your connected WoopSocial accounts):

  • X (Twitter)
  • Facebook
  • Instagram
  • LinkedIn
  • LinkedIn Pages
  • Pinterest

Notes:

  • This WordPress plugin does not include TikTok/YouTube delivery as these are not text/image based platforms.
  • Available channels depend on the social accounts you have connected to WoopSocial within your selected project.

How the plugin works

  1. You publish a post on your WordPress website
  2. The plugin automatically checks your set up rules (which post types, categories/tags filters, and any safety delay / dedicated times you’ve selected)
  3. The plugin creates platform-specific messages using your own templates
  4. The plugin pushes the social media messages per social media platform
  5. WoopSocial queues and publishes to your selected destinations on social media.
  6. The plugin then records an audit entry in wp-admin, retries failures automatically, and tracks final failures in a dead-letter log.

API key integration

To connect the plugin:

  1. In WordPress admin, go to Settings > Social Autopublish.
  2. Generate or copy your API key from woopsocial.com/api-access (or from the WoopSocial Dashboard left sidebar).
  3. Paste your key into the API key field and click Save API Key and Get Projects.
  4. Select your Project, then Save Project Selection.
  5. In Destination social accounts, select one or more destination accounts per social media platform.
  6. Configure any required Pinterest settings (board selection) and save changes.
  7. Publish your first post.

Core features

  • Automatic publishing when a post transitions to published (when enabled)
  • Manual Send to WoopSocial now action in the post editor
  • Per-platform message templates using {title} and {url} placeholders
    • Templates are configured inside the destination account section (next to each platform)
  • UTM tracking (utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign) when enabled
  • Smart queue windows to post only during specific times of the day
  • Optional category/tag filtering
  • Pinterest board selection (supports selecting multiple boards per Pinterest account)
  • Image rules:
    • Instagram and Pinterest require a featured image on the WordPress post (the plugin uploads it via POST /media) as the platforms require this for every post
    • X, LinkedIn, and Facebook rely on link previews from your templates (use {url} in templates)
  • Retry handling with dead-letter tracking and an audit log in wp-admin

Who this is for

  • Content marketers distributing blog content across many channels
  • SEO teams who want social amplification immediately on publish
  • Agencies managing multiple brands via WoopSocial
  • Store owners sharing product and announcement posts automatically

External services

This plugin connects to the WoopSocial API to validate your API key, load your WoopSocial projects and social accounts, fetch Pinterest boards, upload featured images for supported networks, and publish posts to your selected destinations.

When data is sent:

  • On connection checks and settings refresh, the plugin sends your configured API key to WoopSocial endpoints to validate connectivity and retrieve your available projects/social accounts/boards.
  • When a post is published (or manually sent), the plugin sends post content (title, URL, message template output), selected destination account IDs, and scheduling data.
  • For Pinterest and Instagram flows that require media, the plugin uploads the post featured image file to WoopSocial before publishing.

Service provider: WoopSocial

Privacy Policy: https://woopsocial.com/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  2. Go to Settings > Social Autopublish.
  3. Paste your API key.
  4. Configure post filters, destination accounts, and templates.
  5. Save changes.
  6. Publish a post to trigger automation.
sections.faq:
Do I need a WoopSocial account?

Yes. You need a WoopSocial account, connected social profiles, and an API key. Create an account at https://woopsocial.com and retrieve your API key from https://app.woopsocial.com/api-access.

Can I test without sending live posts?

No simulation mode is enabled in this version. The plugin sends to the live WoopSocial API using your configured API key.

Can I choose specific post types only?

Yes. Select which WordPress content types should be auto-shared.

Can I send to specific channels only?

Yes. Select one or more destination accounts in the platform-grouped account checkboxes.

Do I need a featured image for Instagram and Pinterest?

Yes. If you selected Instagram or Pinterest, the plugin requires the WordPress featured image so it can upload it to WoopSocial via POST /media.

Can I turn off auto-posting?

Yes. In your plugin settings, disable “Enable automatic publishing” in Publish Rules and save changes.

What about Pinterest boards?

You can select one or more boards per Pinterest account. The plugin will publish to every selected board.

Do X, LinkedIn, and Facebook require an image?

No. Those platforms use link previews from your message templates. Make sure your templates include {url}.
